code.description: Python 3 source code to execute. State is NOT preserved between calls; print() anything you need to see.

packages.description: Optional PyPI packages to install for this run, e.g. ["pandas", "httpx"]. Cached between runs by uv.

working_dir.description: Optional working directory for the Python process. Defaults to the system temp directory.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds (1-120). Defaults to 30. First run with new packages may be slower while uv downloads them.
